verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's chat guide says developers can ask follow-up questions, request clarifications, challenge recommendations, and explore alternatives in conversation on its feedback. A documented @coderabbitai command set covers review, full review, pause/resume, resolve, configuration, and generating improvements, and chat conversations feed learnings for future reviews. A community commenter notes you can reply in the PR and it will supposedly remember, but this is only a thin mention. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that its in-thread answers are accurate and context-aware.
